body:
Maria: Quick preflight for next week's global webinar — main topics: registration locales, interpretation channels, recording retention (legal needs sign-off), and follow-up language routing. Heads up: 3 speakers across PST/CEST/SGT.
Priya: For locales I added language toggles on the reg page (EN/FR/DE/JA) and locale-specific UTMs. Link: https://redwood.ai/events/global-webinar-localized . Also added timezone auto-detect.
Lucas: Zoom plan: run as Webinar to get Q&A + panelists. We need 2 interpretation channels (French, Japanese) + captions. Zoom supports interpretation on webinars. Anyone confirmed interpreters?
Ana: We can use live interpreters for FR/JA. Also preparing translated email copy and subject lines. Will need final speaker bios asap for the localized promo snippets.
Maria: Bios — pinging @Speakers to drop 2-sentence bios into the form. Deadline EOD today.
Rui: Recording retention: legal requires 90-day retention for EU registrants, 180-day for enterprise customers. Also need consent logging per GDPR for recording and reuse. Where are we storing consent?
Priya: Consent flag is captured on the reg form (checkbox) and saved as form field consent_recording:true in Marketo. We'll also store a timestamp in the event log.
Sam (AV Ops): AV notes: cloud recording ON, local backup on moderator laptop, separate feed for interpretation channels recorded as separate streams if possible. OBS will record a combined feed too.
zoom-bot: Webinar created: ID 123-321-123, start 2026-04-22T17:00:00Z, webinar mode enabled, interpretation channels: FR, JA. Join: https://zoom.us/w/123321123
caption-bot: Live captions enabled via vendor: Vocalink.ai. SRT push to s3://redwood-marketing/global-webinar/captions/; human-QC option available (Ana to confirm).
Ana: For localization handoffs: I'll convert SRT -> VTT and generate translated subtitles for the 24h clip. Also prepare translated CTAs for follow-up email.
Lucas: Rehearsal schedule: greenroom 30m before; full technical run (slides + mics + video) 1hr prior with interpreters joining at 45m prior. Can interpreters do a 10-min mic check?
Priya: Confirmed interpreters available at rehearsal time. I'll send calendar invites in their preferred timezones.
Maria: Follow-up segmentation: attendees get language tag (lang_en/lang_fr/lang_ja) and receive localized nurture. No-shows get replay link but in original registration language. Enterprise leads should get SDR ping within 2 hours.
Priya: I'll map lang tag -> Marketo list mapping. Also added a field "enterprise_flag" via reg form for faster routing.
Rui: One legal requirement: include an explicit checkbox if we will share recording clips externally. For EU registrants, the default must be opt-in. Make sure the reg form reflects that.
Maria: Good catch. Priya, update form copy to have separate checkboxes: 1) consent recording 2) consent external clips. EU default = unchecked for external.
Priya: Updated. Also added a microcopy tooltip explaining how clips are used.
Sam (AV Ops): Runbook snippet to paste in greenroom for interpreters and recording:
```
Zoom webinar settings:
- Interpretation: ENABLED (FR, JA)
- Record separate audio files for panelists: ENABLE
- Cloud recording: ON (audio+video+chat)
- Local backup: Moderator laptop -> /Volumes/Backup/webinars/
- OBS mirror stream: rtmp://live.cdn/intl-mirror
Start sequence:
1) Start cloud recording
2) Start OBS local record
3) Confirm interpreter channel feeds live
```
Maria: Email A/B subjects for localized sends (please vote): EN-A "How Redwood keeps LLM features fast everywhere" EN-B "Serve LLM features with predictable latency — global best practices"
Ana: For FR: "Comment garantir des fonctionnalités LLM rapides partout" and "Latence prévisible et coûts maîtrisés pour vos features LLM". I can shorten if needed for mobile.
Lucas: Also need speaker approval for localized copy. Maria, can you loop them in?
Maria: On it. Also, who's doing post-event clip triage per language?
Kevin (Video) is out today but will handle main edits; Ana takes subs/translation. Sam can hand off recordings to Video via GDrive link.
Sam (AV Ops): I'll upload raws to GDrive: Marketing/Events/GlobalWebinar/raws/ after event. Notarizing filenames with UTC ts.
Rui: Retention policy note to include in runbook (paste and acknowledge):
"Recordings containing EU personal data will be retained for 90 days unless explicit enterprise retention override approved by legal. External clip reuse requires explicit opt-in"
Maria: Acknowledged. We'll include short text in confirmation email linking to privacy page.
Priya: Post-event workflow: 0-2h: enterprise SDR ping; 24h: localized clips + transcript email with CTA; 72h: longer on-demand asset + demo CTA for engaged users. I'll wire this in Marketo.
Ana: Translation timeline for clips: auto-translate first pass within 24h, human proof by EOD+3 for FR/JA.
Lucas: Anything else on logistics? Slides versioning? Please upload final slides to GDrive by +4h before event.
Maria: Final checklist: reg copy updated (Priya), interpretation booked (Priya/Ana), legal sign-off on retention + checkboxes (Rui), AV runbook posted (Sam), localized assets plan (Ana). Please confirm by EOD.
Priya: Confirmed.
Lucas: Confirmed.
Sam (AV Ops): Confirmed and runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/redwood-runbooks/global-webinar
Ana: Confirmed. Translators invited.
Rui: Confirmed on retention language.
Maria: Great — reconvene 1hr before show in #greenroom. :rocket:
